text: [warmly] This is the story of Pidge. A small pigeon, in a very big kitchen, with places to be.
Every legend begins somewhere. Pidge's began beside a pot of soup... and a very angry chef.
[softly] Pidge looked up. Somewhere above the cabinets, the sky was waiting.
And so, once again, Pidge chose violence. Against gravity, specifically.
The chef had plans for Pidge. Pidge had wings. Only one of them was getting their way.
[amused] And just like that, Pidge was back in the kitchen. Some say this is how all legends work.
Heaven, it turns out, has a back door. It opens directly above the soup.
The circle of life. Or, as Pidge would come to call it... the circle of pots.
The kitchen fell away. Ahead lay the Dessert. Hot sand, hard rocks, and absolutely no cake.
[dryly] Someone had misspelled desert on the map. Pidge did not find this funny. The cacti did.
Out the window and into the wild. The chef's shouting faded. The cacti began to whisper.
Pidge burst into open sky, and the sun said hello. Loudly.
[awed] And then... the clouds parted. Bird Heaven. A golden halo, and not a single cat.
[softly] Pidge had made it. For one moment, there was nothing to dodge. Just sky.
Bird Heaven. Where the breadcrumbs are free, and the wind only ever blows upward.
[shouting] HEY! That is my GOOD knife!
[furious] You dodged the pot?! The pot NEVER misses!
Get back here, you feathered appetizer!
[shouting] Somebody close the window! The soup is escaping!
So close! [growls] Next time, you are SOUP!
[shouting] FLAP HARDER! My souffle has more lift than you!
Oh, you are tired? [laughs] The oven is nice and warm...
You call that flapping? I have seen livelier rotisserie chickens!
[mockingly] Rest your wings, little bird. Right here. On this plate.
[triumphant] Into the pot! FINALLY, some good stock!
[laughs] Pigeon casserole! Tonight, we feast!
[gasps] My knives! Do you know how long I sharpened those?!
Diced! Julienned! [chef's kiss] Perfectly prepared!
[laughs] Flipped like a pancake! Magnificent!
Sizzle sizzle! That is the sound of DINNER!
[cackles] Good kitty! Good kitty gets the drumstick!
Even the cat is on my side! [laughs] Even the CAT!
[shouting] LEGENDARY FLOP! Straight back onto my cutting board!
Gravity, my old friend. [chuckles] Thank you for the delivery.
And so Pidge met the cactus. Historians agree... the cactus did not move.
[sighs] The cactus had one job. Unfortunately, it was very good at it.
The rock had sat there for ten thousand years. It was not about to move for a pigeon.
[dryly] A legendary flop, in the sand. The rock would tell this story for centuries.
[solemnly] And so Pidge fell. Not from grace. Just from a fairly normal height.
Pidge stopped flapping. Physics, which had been very patient, did not.
The cat had waited all day for this. [sighs] Honestly? Good for the cat.
Pidge saw the paw. Pidge understood the paw. Pidge did not move. A legendary flop.
Not every legend has a happy ending. [pause] Most of them, though, get a second try.
[softly] Rest now, Pidge. The kitchen will wait. It always does.
[excited] OHHH! By a FEATHER!
WHAT a dodge! Did you SEE that?!
[shouting] Threading the needle! This bird has NO fear!
Close shave! The crowd is on its FEET!
[laughs] Oh-ho-ho! That cactus is FURIOUS!
Too hot to handle! Nothing in this desert can touch that bird!
[excited] Another milestone! This pigeon is ON THE RISE!
Higher and higher! Somebody call air traffic control!
Look at those WINGS go! Absolutely textbook!
Up, up, and AWAY! The sky is getting nervous!
Keep it coming! This is a feathered FREIGHT TRAIN!
[shouting] NEW PERSONAL BEST! Put it in the record books!
[excited] RECORD BROKEN! The old you never stood a chance!
A new high score! Ladies and gentlemen, history is being FLAPPED!
[warmly] Higher than ever before. Pidge would remember this moment. Briefly.
[shouting] PIDGE IS ON FIRE!
Look at those arms GO! UNSTOPPABLE!
[excited] Flap frenzy! FLAP FRENZY!
Somebody get this bird a sponsorship deal!
[urgently] Keep flapping! Keep FLAPPING!
Uh oh, the wings are slowing down! Don't quit now!
[gasps] Is that... a nap? MID-AIR?!
[excited] Worm acquired! Protein, baby!
Ooh, a juicy one! Snack break!
Wiggle wiggle, GULP! Fuel for the flight!
